system.summary: Names only, inside clear French: 9 groups each used once (figures with marks above them, plain figures, single signs such as #, X, -o-, barred 4, 5 capped by a bar, barred Z). Probably one of Bongars's tables in BnF fr. 7129 (Cryptiana catalogue), not seen.

prior_solution.where: Lead 2453 (Daniel Bourdeau, Swiss cantonal sweep; vetting v16 of 9 Nov 2026 closed it as not_cipher, no reading). Anquez 1887 cites other Cod. B 149 items but not these two in the OCR searched; the Bongars letter editions (1647, 1668-1695) are the Latin letters. Kohlndorfer-Fries 2009 and Hagen 1875 not checked.

conditions.human_role: Daniel Bourdeau's sweep found the leaves (lead 2453). Brice Dudout set the rules (levels fixed in a pre-registration before any identification; no key claimed without a period table). An AI agent transcribed, identified and wrote up. No human palaeographer checked the transcription.
models: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic), agent run by Brice Dudout

solution.what: Daniel's catalogue and lead vetting; Anquez 1887 (full-text OCR); web searches for the letter and for a Bongars nomenclator; Cryptiana catalogue of Bongars ciphers (BnF fr. 7125-7132).
Both leaves transcribed in full (about 690 words of clear French), the 9 nomenclator groups noted as written.

Names recovered from grammar and the history of Jan 1597 (Ancel's mission, the 1596 league, the Strasbourg bishopric quarrel): 3 probable (les Estats, the Spaniard, Queen Elizabeth), 2 restored (Cardinal de Lorraine, House of Austria), 4 open.

outcome.method_basis: No enciphered text to decode: the letters are clear French with single nomenclator groups for names. Names were inferred from context, not from a key.

texts.label: Cod. B 149 (A) 451-452, ff. 360r-v, two letters of 26 Jan 1597
texts.summary: Bongars urges that the States General write to the German princes Ancel is visiting, complains of the English Queen's servants, and corrects his report on Brandenburg; at Strasbourg the bishopric quarrel worsens, an envoy demands 70,000 florins, and he fears the see will fall to a third party.
texts.note: read_share counts words: about 690 clear words read; 4 nomenclator groups and 3 doubtful words open. The names, not the words, are the weak part: 3 probable, 2 restored, 4 open of 9.

reading_review.note: clear French read as sentences; group identifications by context only, levels fixed in advance; one reader

outcome.notes: A small contribution on a lead closed as not_cipher: full transcription and names recovered in part from context. No key and no decipherment claimed.
